llm_judge_details.justification: The topology covers most core VNFs (NRF, UDM, UDR, AUSF, NSSF, AMF, SMF, UPF, gNB) but omits the PCF, which is important for QoS control of the URLLC slice, leading to partial completeness. VNF types and inter‑connections follow 3GPP 23.501 conventions, though the missing PCF is a minor deviation, so correctness is high. Allocated CPU/memory values are very low for the advertised 1 Gbps throughput and 10 ms latency, especially for eMBB cameras, indicating insufficient resources. Slice definitions (eMBB for cameras, URLLC for PLC) correctly match the intent, earning full marks on slice alignment. The SLA latency of 10 ms is generous for URLLC control loops (typically <1 ms), making the SLA only partially suitable.
